description:
Verify the logical producing-input closure is complete before a timed run starts.

## Background

`survey/make-logical-producing-inputs.py` enumerates the harness, measured-crate and campaign-support sources into `survey/logical-producing-inputs.json`, and the window guard (`logical-campaign inputs`) refuses a timed run when any listed path is untracked or dirty. The listing is a snapshot: a source added to a measured crate after the last regeneration (for example `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/byte_table.rs`, which the rework-2 regeneration of bb769456 picked up) is absent from the closure until someone regenerates it, so a dirty new source could be timed unnoticed. The manifest set is guarded by a contract test since bb769456 rework 2; the source sections are not.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The window guard, or a step the launcher runs immediately before it, regenerates the closure from the current tree and refuses the run when the regenerated closure differs from the committed `survey/logical-producing-inputs.json`, naming every added or removed path.
- [hard] REQ-02: A harness contract test adds a source file under a measured crate in a scratch tree and asserts the check refuses; the committed closure on main is regenerated in the same change and its diff is only the paths the current tree adds.
- [hard] REQ-03: The smoke, the validation record and every committed logical evidence file stay byte-identical except the regenerated closure; `./scripts/cargo-ci.sh` passes.

## Notes

Reported by the bb769456 rework-2 worker (session 18, observation 1). Untimed work. Depends on bb769456; the three logical baseline records run after it.
